notes.note: Changed the Retry sentence: pressing Retry during a background re-read shows the loading state at once and reads again after the running re-read ends, like any other reload (the earlier 'shows its progress rather than starting another' described a join that was removed because it applied to every reload caller). Checked against PluginRegistry.reload (queues a fresh pass; sets loading when a background re-read is in flight) and performReload (background pass leaves the final status to the queued pass). Executed: PluginRegistry.timeout tests for Retry (loading then degraded, 9 reads) and a non-Retry reload getting a fresh successful read; live: Retry at 64 s showed the skeleton until the fresh pass failed at 161 s, then the error stayed through the next background re-read.
